result.claim: Only this bounded selection; no native aggregate or release qualification.

scope: Seven upgrade cases run against two disposable builds and the existing switchable release server: exact asset bytes, first-install offline reopen, multi-tab waiting, interrupted and wrong-byte downloads with retry, renderer death and compatible rollback, and the immediate-activation sensitivity control. The optional actual-predecessor case is explicitly not applicable because no predecessor build is supplied; its named reason must match exactly and it grants no predecessor-upgrade evidence. The independent predecessor-input/wrapper obligation remains open. Two native adapter controls rerun ordinary passing/omitted/skipped/failed census and cancellation/deadline ownership. All application assertions and 35-second case bounds remain unchanged; the 240-second file bound includes both builds. The server factory preserves the standalone fixed-port command while owned runs use an ephemeral loopback server. The reconciler accepts only the exact declared non-applicable case/reason and still refuses every unexpected skip, inverted outcome, retry or annotation. Evidence counts distinguish passes from explicitly unexercised dispositions. This bounded selection is not immutable release qualification.
